summary: Biotricity Inc. filed an 8-K reporting exchange agreements under which holders of 14.1M common shares, 3.99M options, and 1.44M warrants exchanged these securities for 1.96M newly created Series C Preferred shares (10 Exchange Securities per Preferred share). Series C carries 40 votes per share and automatically converts to 59.6% of outstanding common upon a qualified equity offering of at least $15M; if none by March 31, 2028, holders may convert each Preferred share to 10 common shares. The filing cites Section 4(a)(2) exemption. This debt-for-equity swap restructures the cap table and voting control; watch for potential dilutive effect on existing common holders and whether a qualified financing occurs before the conversion deadline.
